docs.message:
docs(pdt42): map the ecosystem (D1)

## Intent

Start strategy design: give every entity of the ecosystem its platform role and add the platform with its owner. lernapps.net builds its infrastructure on GitHub on purpose, but is far too small for a relationship with it.

## Key changes

- E2 gives every entity a role: creators are peer-producers, adopting adults and students peer-consumers, school gatekeepers stakeholders, and teacher platforms, social media and AI assistants partners.
- GitHub has no role. It is the means of production in the platform's infrastructure: issue templates, GitHub Actions workflows and the apps with their labels.
- The text says why AI assistants stay a partner (the platform has to design for them), why social media stays one despite little potential, and why six peer roles stay instead of five.
- A new D1 chapter holds the Ecosystem Canvas, the entity "Platform owner" (Oliver Jägle only) and the platform block "lernapps.net", referring to the ecosystem, the brief and the owner.
- The development plan marks D1 done and adds KD-10.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Two hints stay open on purpose: GitHub without a role (H101) and six peer roles (H102).
